messages.content: I shipped the chair back on January 18 via USPS. Here's the tracking number: 9400111899223100567890. Can you please process my refund?
I see the tracking number but it only shows a label was created. There's no scan showing USPS actually received the package. I'll issue the refund once I receive the chair back.
I dropped it off at the post office in person. USPS has been having delays — sometimes packages don't scan for days. I have the drop-off receipt. Please process the refund, I've held up my end.

A receipt for a label doesn't prove the package was given to USPS. The tracking should show at least an acceptance scan. I've called USPS and they have no record of receiving this package. I need to actually get the chair back before a refund.
